BEFORE WE BUILD

Questions, answered.

What does ORBITAL build?

ORBITAL builds business websites, mobile apps, and practical AI or workflow automations. Services cover discovery, design, development, and launch preparation.

Where is ORBITAL based, and can we work remotely?

ORBITAL is based in India and works remotely with clients. Our client markets include the UAE, the Philippines, the USA, Europe, India, and Kenya.

Can I see examples of your work?

Yes. Explore the portfolio for project descriptions, screenshots, and links to available websites or app-store listings. Projects without an available public release have no external launch button.

How do you estimate cost and timeline?

Share the problem you want to solve, the features you need, and any target launch date. Scope, integrations, content, and platform requirements shape the estimate; there is no single fixed price or timeline for every project.

How do I start a project?

Use the enquiry form, email rounakpro18@gmail.com, or start a WhatsApp conversation on +91 9322942635. Tell us about your business and what you want to build.
